reasons.PluginCheck.Security.DirectDB.UnescapedD: ReservationRepository::ids() and ::scalar() are the booking engine's two single-statement executors: each runs one query and turns a database error into the engine's typed failure (guard()), which the race-safe claim/reschedule paths depend on. Every caller passes the return value of $wpdb->prepare() -- ids(): 2 callers, scalar(): 3 call sites, one of which appends only the constant ' FOR UPDATE' -- with the table bound as %i and every value bound; no request input reaches either helper unprepared. The sniff reports the variable argument, not an unescaped value. Measured 2026-11-18 (Task 17): the other 38 instances of this warning were removed by binding table names with %i and inlining the prepare() call; these two remain by design.
